title: Streamlined weight handoff and profiling pipeline for community models
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline that automates intake of community-hosted model weights, converts them to Redwood runtime artifacts, runs a standardized set of functional and perf validations, and publishes a versioned performance profile to the model catalog. The pipeline must support: resumable large-file transfer, deterministic conversion with reproducible hashes, GPU/CPU profile passes, automated pin suggestion for a compatible runtime binary, and publishing metadata with provenance (origin URL, sha256, transform steps).
acceptance_criteria: 1) We can ingest a 50GB HF model from a third-party S3/HTTP/CORS host with retry and resume; 2) Conversion step produces a runtime-ready artifact and outputs a stable artifact hash; 3) Validation run produces latency and memory profiles for p50/p95 with the same harness used by perf dashboards; 4) The model catalog receives a new versioned profile entry with links to artifact, conversion logs, and benchmark CSV; 5) Rollout job demonstrates pin suggestion that maps to an existing runtime build; 6) End-to-end tests in CI pass and a canary onboarding succeeds on staging cluster.
implementation_notes:
- Intake agent: extend weights-ingest worker to add support for HTTP range resume and signed URL rotation.
- Conversion: wrap existing openmodel-bridge conversion into containerized step that emits provenance.json and normalized tensor format.
- Validation harness: reuse runtime perf harness with a new pipeline mode that runs small sequence-length sweeps, memory peak captures (NVIDIA SMI + jemalloc), and kv-cache stress tests.
- Publishing: add atomic publish API that writes profile to catalog and triggers cache invalidation.
- Pin flow: heuristic engine proposes model->runtime pin based on peak memory and sequence length profile; allow manual override in console.
- Security: ensure KMS-wrapped credentials for private S3 origins and scan all conversion containers with base-image SBOM.
test_plan:
- Unit tests: coverage for resume logic, hash reproducibility, and publish API.
- Integration: ingest->convert->validate pipeline runs in CI using a 200MB synthetic model; compare output hashes to a golden.
- Perf: run stg cluster canary using a real community model (50M-1B parameter range) to validate latency p95 under target batch sizes.
- Fault injection: simulate transient storage errors and assert pipeline resumes and surface correct error telemetry.
- Regression: add nightly job that re-validates a sample of previously onboarded models to detect drift.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge feature flags behind 'onboarding-v2' gate. 2) Deploy intake and conversion components to staging and run 5 canaries with different origins. 3) Validate profiling outputs against dashboard baselines. 4) Enable in limited hosted catalog (internal-only) for 48h. 5) Open beta to internal teams and one external partner. 6) Full public rollout after two weeks of monitoring and resolving issues.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: Large-file ingest spikes S3 ingress costs. Mitigation: rate-limit and backpressure, S3 multipart threshold tuning.
- Risk: Conversion produces non-deterministic artifacts across hardware. Mitigation: deterministic seed for conversion steps and reproducible environment container.
- Risk: Profiling runs cause GPU contention in shared staging. Mitigation: schedule isolated profiling windows on dedicated pools.
- Risk: Incorrect pin suggestions cause runtime OOMs. Mitigation: conservative safety margin and manual approval gate for initial rollouts.
